## Notes

All three candidates in the pool (inv1, dom1, agg1) are byte-identical to the base harness. The harness.diff for each shows "(no change)". No edit rows can be written because no components were modified.

The execution outcomes differ (inv1 produced `<no, no, yes>` [incorrect], while dom1 and agg1 each produced `<no, yes, no>` [correct], matching the base rollout), but this variance is not tied to harness changes—it is pure model variance across separate LLM calls. The adoption of agg1 reflects only that it was designated "single final at k=1" in a trivial pool with no changes, not that any harness edit was evaluated or found to help.
